concerns.text: The specification assumes the existence of a ‘Reddit Loneliness Longitudinal Dataset’ that contains validated UCLA Loneliness Scale scores and baseline raw text for each user (see Assumptions). No publicly‑available dataset matching this description is known; existing Reddit loneliness corpora are unstructured posts without self‑report survey items. Without a valid source of the dependent variable, the core research question (AI usage → loneliness change) is unanswerable, making the entire methodological design unsound.
